messages.subject: code resuse and robustness
parts:
I often use R and ggplot2 to analyze data and the produce analyses and
it is great. Unfortunately my code reuse patterns suck, i.e. too much
copy and paste. Does anyone know of good references to writing
reusable classes that can help me think about how to speed up my
analysis process and reduce time spent hunting dumb bugs, as opposed
to thinking about the bugs that result from not understanding my data
or problem? R and ggplot2 just seem to make it so easy to write bad
code.
